questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to prudent?
questions.explanation: Prudent means showing careful judgment, so sensible is the closest synonym.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to commence?
questions.explanation: To commence an activity is to begin it.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to evident?
questions.explanation: Evident means clearly seen or understood, which is apparent.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to optimistic?
questions.explanation: Optimistic means expecting favorable results, while pessimistic means expecting unfavorable results.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to permit?
questions.explanation: Permit means allow, while forbid means refuse to allow.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to shallow?
questions.explanation: Shallow describes little depth, and deep is its direct opposite.

questions.prompt: Keyboard is to type as telescope is to ____.
questions.explanation: A keyboard is used to type, while a telescope is used to observe.

questions.prompt: Chef is to restaurant as judge is to ____.
questions.explanation: A chef works in a restaurant, just as a judge works in a courtroom.

questions.prompt: Flour is to wheat as paper is to ____.
questions.explanation: Flour is produced from wheat, while paper is produced from wood.

questions.prompt: Which choice is the only word outside the group?
questions.explanation: Gallon, liter, and quart measure capacity; kilogram measures mass.

questions.prompt: Which word belongs with honest, truthful, and sincere?
questions.explanation: Honest, truthful, sincere, and candid all describe openness and truthfulness.

questions.prompt: January, April, and October share which objective characteristic?
questions.explanation: January, April, and October are all months of the year.

questions.prompt: A code uses exactly three symbols. The star appears before the circle. The triangle appears after the circle. Which symbol is last?
questions.explanation: Star comes before circle, and triangle follows circle, so triangle must be last.

questions.prompt: Every copper key opens cabinet P. Key R does not open cabinet P. Which conclusion must be true?
questions.explanation: Every copper key opens P; since R does not, it cannot be copper.

questions.prompt: A meeting is scheduled for Tuesday, Thursday, or Saturday. It cannot occur Tuesday if Mira attends, and it can occur Saturday only if Leo attends. Mira attends, but Leo does not. When must the meeting occur?
questions.explanation: Mira rules out Tuesday and Leo's absence rules out Saturday, leaving Thursday.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to meticulous?
questions.explanation: Meticulous means extremely careful about details.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to adjacent?
questions.explanation: Adjacent things are next to or neighboring each other.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to compensate?
questions.explanation: To compensate is to repay someone for work or loss.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to hostile?
questions.explanation: Hostile means unfriendly; friendly is its opposite.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to maximum?
questions.explanation: Maximum is the greatest amount; minimum is the least.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to ascend?
questions.explanation: Ascend means move upward, while descend means move downward.

questions.prompt: Nest is to bird as den is to ____.
questions.explanation: A nest shelters a bird, while a den shelters a bear.

questions.prompt: Edit is to manuscript as prune is to ____.
questions.explanation: Editing improves a manuscript; pruning improves a hedge.

questions.prompt: Minute is to hour as centimeter is to ____.
questions.explanation: A minute is a smaller unit within an hour, as a centimeter is within a meter.

questions.prompt: Which word differs in category from the other three?
questions.explanation: The other words describe materials that transmit at least some light.

questions.prompt: Which word belongs with canoe, ferry, and sailboat?
questions.explanation: All four are types of watercraft.

questions.prompt: Copper, gold, and aluminum share which category?
questions.explanation: Copper, gold, and aluminum are metals.

questions.prompt: Exactly one of Arun and Bella leads. If Bella leads, Chen records notes. Chen is not recording notes. Who must lead?
questions.explanation: Bella cannot lead because that would require Chen to record, so Arun leads.

questions.prompt: All blue cards are numbered. No numbered card is blank. Which conclusion must be true?
questions.explanation: Blue cards are numbered, and numbered cards cannot be blank.

questions.prompt: Four books W, X, Y, and Z are stacked. W is above X. Y is below X. Z is above W. Which book is second from the top?
questions.explanation: The forced order is Z, W, X, Y.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to vivid?
questions.explanation: Vivid means strikingly clear, bright, or detailed.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to scarce?
questions.explanation: Scarce means available only in a limited amount.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to allocate?
questions.explanation: To allocate is to assign something for a particular purpose.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to vertical?
questions.explanation: Vertical runs up and down; horizontal runs from side to side.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to deliberate?
questions.explanation: Deliberate means intentional; accidental means unintentional.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to compulsory?
questions.explanation: Compulsory means required; optional means left to choice.

questions.prompt: Battery is to flashlight as fuel is to ____.
questions.explanation: A battery supplies a flashlight with energy; fuel supplies an engine with energy.

questions.prompt: Bud is to flower as egg is to ____.
questions.explanation: A bud develops into a flower, as an egg develops into a butterfly.

questions.prompt: Thermometer is to temperature as compass is to ____.
questions.explanation: A thermometer indicates temperature; a compass indicates direction.

questions.prompt: Which term does not belong with the other three?
questions.explanation: The other choices are landforms; a harbor is a sheltered body of water.

questions.prompt: Which word belongs with soprano, alto, and tenor?
questions.explanation: Soprano, alto, tenor, and bass are vocal ranges.

questions.prompt: Rectangle, trapezoid, and kite share which category?
questions.explanation: Each figure is a polygon with four sides.

questions.prompt: Mira, Owen, and Paz each choose one different workshop: art, coding, or drama. Mira does not choose art. Owen chooses coding. Which workshop must Paz choose if Mira chooses drama?
questions.explanation: Coding is taken by Owen and drama by Mira, leaving art for Paz.

questions.prompt: If the alarm is armed, opening the door triggers a bell. The door opens, but no bell sounds. Which conclusion follows?
questions.explanation: The stated rule means an armed alarm and an opened door would produce a bell.

questions.prompt: Five runners finish with J before K, K before L, and M before J. N finishes after L. Who must finish first?
questions.explanation: The constraints force M before J before K before L before N.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to impartial?
questions.explanation: Impartial means fair and not favoring one side.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to abundant?
questions.explanation: Abundant means existing in a plentiful amount.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to inevitable?
questions.explanation: Inevitable describes something certain to happen and therefore unavoidable.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to ancient?
questions.explanation: Ancient means very old; modern means belonging to recent times.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to unanimous?
questions.explanation: A unanimous group agrees completely; a divided group does not.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to include?
questions.explanation: Include means contain as part of a whole; exclude means leave out.

questions.prompt: Itinerary is to journey as outline is to ____.
questions.explanation: An itinerary plans a journey; an outline plans a speech.

questions.prompt: Odometer is to distance as scale is to ____.
questions.explanation: An odometer measures distance, while a scale measures weight.

questions.prompt: Roof is to house as lid is to ____.
questions.explanation: A roof covers a house; a lid covers a jar.

questions.prompt: Which word does not belong with the other three?
questions.explanation: The other choices are musical instruments; a lantern provides light.

questions.prompt: Which word belongs with copper, iron, and silver?
questions.explanation: Copper, iron, silver, and tin are metals.

questions.prompt: Which pair has the same relationship as calf and cow?
questions.explanation: A calf is the young of a cow; a foal is the young of a horse.

questions.prompt: All members of the robotics club attend the safety meeting. Inez is a robotics club member. What must be true?
questions.explanation: The general rule applies to every club member, including Inez.

questions.prompt: Four books—J, K, L, and M—stand on a shelf. J is left of K. M is right of K. L is left of J. Which book is farthest left?
questions.explanation: The constraints produce the order L, J, K, M.

questions.prompt: No glass objects are flexible. Some rulers are flexible. Which conclusion follows?
questions.explanation: Any flexible ruler cannot be glass, so at least some rulers are not glass.
